prompt: Vertical cinematic video. Evening in a modern single-story Florida home in Naples with palm trees visible through large windows. A smiling woman in her 40s walks into the living room holding groceries and says in Spanish: "Enciende las luces de la sala." The warm ceiling lights and lamps smoothly turn on, the blinds lower automatically, and a friendly voice answers in Spanish: "Listo, luces encendidas." She smiles and sets the bags down. Warm, bright, professional real-estate commercial look, soft golden light, slow dolly-in camera.
